name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on the request for waiver of the immunity of Klára Dobrev
part_text:
The European Parliament has decided not to lift the legal protection of Klára Dobrev, a Hungarian member of the European Parliament. A Hungarian court asked for this protection to be removed so she could face a private criminal complaint over a social media post from February 2024. Parliament judged that the case looks like an attempt to harm her political work rather than to repair real reputational damage, so her protection stays in place.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Dobrev keeps her protection, so the Hungarian case cannot go ahead for now.
- **Who it affects:** Klára Dobrev and the private complainant who brought the defamation case in Hungary.
- **What happens next:** Parliament's President sends the decision to the Hungarian court and to Dobrev.
